items.title: Classify transcript-diff as a narrow lifecycle artifact
items.context: Update lifecycle artifact scope classification so only the controlled story-scoped evidence/transcript-diff.md path is allowed. Arbitrary evidence files, unknown .koala files, and product source changes must still fail when out of scope.

happy.desc: story-scoped evidence/transcript-diff.md is classified as a lifecycle artifact and does not produce OUT_OF_SCOPE.

edge.desc: the allowed transcript artifact must still require a valid story-scoped path and story id.

adversarial.desc: arbitrary evidence files and unknown .koala files remain out of scope unless explicitly allowed.

items.userSees: Terminal output includes "Scope gate: pass" for .koala/story/actives/B-xxxx/evidence/transcript-diff.md and does not print "OUT_OF_SCOPE" for that file.

verificationEvidence.note: Contract test accepts .koala/story/actives/B-scope/evidence/transcript-diff.md as a lifecycle artifact and reports Process fact contract verified.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:process-fact-contract && npm run test:flow-stability-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Classifier requires a valid story-scoped prefix/storyId and the lifecycle registry projection still passes flow stability after adding the closed relative artifact path.
Regression asserts .koala/foo.json, evidence/notes.md, evidence/transcript-diff.txt, and unrelated source files remain out_of_scope.

items.title: Document and verify TEST transcript scope behavior
items.context: Update the lifecycle artifact policy and add focused regression coverage proving TEST transcript evidence is delivery evidence, not product scope expansion. The regression must explicitly prove the B-bffc incident no longer repeats: when the only diff is .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/evidence/transcript-diff.md, scope_contract_check must not require scope_contract_acknowledge, reviewer evidence must not become stale solely because of that transcript, and the story must not need a TEST→DEV bounce. Delivery-check and ordinary product/docs/test scope acknowledgement rules remain intact.

happy.desc: policy docs state evidence/transcript-diff.md is TEST delivery evidence and does not need scope acknowledgement.

edge.desc: a TEST-phase story whose only new diff is .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/evidence/transcript-diff.md can run scope_contract_check without OUT_OF_SCOPE, without scope_contract_acknowledge, and without invalidating reviewer scope binding.

adversarial.desc: delivery-check remains required, arbitrary evidence files remain out of scope, and ordinary product/docs/test scope expansions still need normal scope handling.

items.userSees: Terminal output includes "Scope gate: pass" for transcript-only evidence, "Verification policy:" during validate, and no "scope_contract_acknowledge" instruction for transcript-diff.md.

verificationEvidence.note: Policy doc states evidence/transcript-diff.md is TEST lifecycle transcript evidence, path-specific, and does not weaken product source scope enforcement.
CLI scope gate printed Scope gate: pass with 13 changed files and 0 unacknowledged violations; no scope_contract_acknowledge instruction was required for lifecycle metadata.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:process-fact-contract && npm run lint:tasks
verificationEvidence.note: Delivery/scope semantics stay separate: process fact contract keeps signed delivery artifacts/gates registered, adversarial evidence files fail scope, and task annotation lint reports PASSED.
